Description: [shortdesc]TOSHIBA MG06ACA10TE enterprise capacity HDD, 8TB, 7200RPM, SATA-6GBPS, 256MB buffer, 512E, 3.5-inch hard disk drive. New with standard manufacturer warranty.[/shortdesc]The MG06ACA enterprise capacity HDD line offers up to 10TB of storage and 7,200 rpm performance in a rugged design built for nearline, business-critical workloads. The MG06ACA generation uses an industry-standard 3.5-inch form factor with 26.1 mm height and Advanced Format sector technology for optimal capacity and data reliability. These models support Toshiba Persistent Write Cache technology to improve performance while maintaining write consistency if power is suddenly lost. With a SATA 6.0 Gbit/s interface, the Enterprise Capacity MG06ACA line helps save rack space and reduce the footprint and operational burden of business-critical servers and storage systems. The MG06ACA Series boosts sustained transfer rate performance to 237 MiB/s and raises MTTF by 25% versus the previous MG05ACA series. 4Kn or 512e Advanced Format sector technology models are available. 4Kn sector models (MG06ACAxxxA) deliver suitable performance and compatibility for 4Kn-capable applications and operating environments. 512e sector models (MG06ACAxxxE) provide support for legacy applications and environments that require 512-byte sector lengths. Key features include: industry-standard 3.5-inch, 26.1 mm-height form factor; large 10TB capacity, plus 8TB and 6TB MG06 Series models; 7,200 rpm performance; SATA 6.0 Gbit/s interface; MTTF 2.5 million hours; 550 total TB transferred per year workload rating; 4Kn or 512e Advanced Format sector technology; Toshiba Persistent Write Cache technology for data-loss protection during sudden power-loss events; improved sustained transfer rate; and Sanitize Instant Erase (SIE) option model availability. Applications: mid-line/nearline business-critical workloads, Tier 2 business-critical servers and storage systems, workloads and use cases that benefit from high capacity per spindle, capacity-optimized storage systems, cloud-scale storage infrastructure, and data archive and backup infrastructure.
